label: Glass Shard Wall
description: Premium 3D stats/mosaic beat for editorial and tempo-cut films: a full-frame wall of dark beveled glass shards (irregular hex mosaic, real three.js) seen at a slight angle, thin specular rims catching warm/cool light, a few tiles parted so dark seams open. Teal monospace text -- a kicker line up top and a stat row in the lower third -- ghosts through from BEHIND the glass. Fills the whole frame (position 0,0 100%x100%); content is composed from frame 1 with slow parallax drift, breathing tiles, and drifting speculars. Deterministic (seeded) -- seeks exactly under render capture.

seed.label: Mosaic layout seed (film-stable; vary per scene)

kicker.label: Top kicker line behind the glass (default 'WRITE HTML → RENDER VIDEO')

stats.label: Stat row [{value,label}], e.g. [{"value":"47x","label":"FASTER THAN AE"}] (default 3 demo stats)

tile_color.label: Glass tile base color (default #3a3230 warm graphite)

accent.label: Text color behind the glass (default #7fd8cf teal)

text_front.label: Text In Front
text_front.description: Default true: type rides above the glass, crisp. false = the original behind-the-glass ghost.
